name: softonoma-orchestrator
description: Softonoma multi-agent feature pipeline: BA/legacy analysis, prototyping, planning, parallel FE/BE/mobile/integrations implementation, QA/security/performance review, PR gate. Stack: Next.js/Vercel/Tailwind, Supabase (Postgres/RLS/Auth), Prisma, Drizzle, MongoDB/Redis, BullMQ, NestJS, FastAPI/Python, React Native/Expo; plus project onboarding (/new-project, /upgrade-project) that creates the standard .claude/ structure and enables the matching optional packs (languages, frontend frameworks, mobile, Flutter, cloud, databases, data/AI, SEO, ops). Legacy Laravel/Vue support.
